newsitem.title: UK: Duty free trade group retains ad agency.
newsitem.headline: Duty free trade group retains ad agency.

text.p: A trade group has retained the Bozell advertising agency to create a campaign to help fight the end to duty-free shopping between member countries of the European Union, a newsletter reported on Monday.
The International Duty Free Confederation has tapped Bozell to create a "major consumer campaign" in each of the EU's member countries, Euromarketing reported.
Duty free shopping between EU countries is scheduled to end in June 1999.
The International Duty Free Confederation lists airlines, airports, and drinks and tobacco manufacturers among its members.
